citations.assessment: The source uses the spelling Einini bar Sasson. It gives him both the comparison to the number of leprous appearances and the juxtaposition of offerings and priestly garments.
Anani expounds at the entrance of the nasi’s household. R. Ammi objects that the teaching was already given by R. Elazar in R. Oshaya’s name.
First the source gives R. Yishmael, then the analysis expands the name to R. Yishmael bar Yose. The printed name of Anani matches the root here.
